text:
anya: Heads-up, ran hybrid AWQ/GPTQ bakeoff on new-7b-variant yesterday. saw a small overall delta but some sharp per-layer/channel spikes breaking AWQ for a subset of prompts.

mike: numbers?

anya: baseline FP16 perf (small eval slice): MMLU 76.2. AWQ 8-bit -> 74.1 (-2.1). GPTQ 4-bit -> 73.8 (-2.4). overall OK but a few chat examples went catastrophically wrong.

julia: do we have per-layer deltas to point to hotspots?

anya: yes — dumped a quick probe across activations. sample output (truncated):
```json
{"layer":45,"channel_outlier_count":23,"kldelta":0.28,"max_act":189.3}
{"layer":80,"channel_outlier_count":41,"kldelta":0.90,"max_act":512.2}
{"layer":101,"channel_outlier_count":7,"kldelta":0.05,"max_act":78.1}
```

sanjay: layer 80 stands out. high kldelta and huge max_act. my vote: try surgical per-channel clamp + per-channel rescale before doing a layer skiplist. cheaper.

mike: agreed. skiplist has higher correctness but forces fallback -> higher cost. clamp approach could recover most samples with tiny perf hit.

anya: ran a quick A/B with clamp on channels in layer 80 where act > 400: clamp to 128 and then per-channel rescale. Results: AWQ MMLU -> 74.8 (improved from 74.1) and the chat failure rate dropped a lot. Latency increased ~+3ms p50.

eval-bot: auto-eval results: prompt-suite pass rate AWQ -> 85%, AWQ+clamp -> 92%. regression set size 1200.

julia: sweet. can you paste the repro command and patch diff?

anya: repro command: `python tools/outlier_probe.py --model new-7b --quant awq --dump-layer 80 --threshold 400 --clamp 128 --rescale-per-channel`
Patch (high level):
```diff
- apply_quant_kernel(...)
+ apply_quant_kernel(..., clamp_map=per_layer_clamp, per_channel_scale=scale_map)
```

sanjay: I'll prepare a small script to compute clamp_map from training stats and upload to S3. naming: `s3://redwood-quant/patches/new-7b/1988881111/clamp_map.json`.

mike: also add a small runtime routing rule: if layer80 outlier hit rate > 0.5% for a customer, route their requests to GPTQ variant for that customer. avoids global fallback.

julia: I'll open the PR for runtime routing: runtime/runtime/quant_fallback.py and add tests.

anya: created config artifact for a skiplist in case clamp doesn't fully recover: `configs/quant-skiplists/new-7b-layer80-suggest.json` (contains layer id + affected channel ranges).

mike: next steps (short):
1) run 1k-chat regression AWQ+clamp (anya)
2) run perf bench with routing rule enabled (mike)
3) instrument per-customer outlier telemetry (julia)

sanjay: I'll produce the clamp_map script and upload by EOD.

anya: logs & data uploaded: s3://redwood-quant/experiments/1988881111/ (contains raw probes, clamp_map, eval results).

mike: tagging: @sanjay @julia @anya for visibility :thumbsup:

incident-bot: note: experiment consumed dedicated-gpu-pool-2 for ~2h, no incidents.
